derivation: from an unused root perhaps meaning to be hollow;

occurrences.text: And David said on that day, Whosoever getteth up to the gutter, and smiteth the Jebusites, and the lame and the blind, that are hated of David’s soul, he shall be chief and captain. Wherefore they said, The blind and the lame shall not come into the house.
Deep calleth unto deep at the noise of thy waterspouts: all thy waves and thy billows are gone over me.
